description: Phase B CM1 validation-anchor case for high low-level moisture and lower cloud-base behavior.
physical_question: How does high near-surface humidity lower the LCL and make low cloud easier to form?
expected_outcome: Lower cloud base and easier cloud formation than the accepted shallow-cumulus baseline.
expected_regime: Lower cloud base and easier cloud formation than the accepted shallow-cumulus baseline.

cloud_scale_policy.local_runtime_cost_note: Roughly 3.4x the prior committed cell count; intended for local validation runs, not app runtime.
cloud_scale_policy.supersedes_note: The earlier 120 km / 2 km-grid output remains workflow/provisional evidence, not final cloud-scale visual validation.

namelist_input_concept.forcing_concept: Moderate sensible heating with stronger moisture supply over a humid lower-layer sounding.

sounding_profile_concept.format_reference: CM1 input_sounding format: first line surface pressure, theta, qv; following lines z, theta, qv, u, v.
sounding_profile_concept.free_atmosphere: Very moist lower layer that dries with height enough to keep the case a contrast rather than default baseline.
sounding_profile_concept.final_level_note: Final sounding level is above ztop/grid top.

expected_output_files: cm1out_stats.nc or cm1out_stats.dat/ctl depending on CM1 output settings
required_fields: pressure or pressure-derived metadata if available

do_not_commit: runtime support files such as LANDUSE.TBL

how_to_ingest: After local output exists, use scripts/reference/cm1/run_validation_batch.sh --execute or scripts/reference/cm1/ingest_cm1_output.py with this case id to map selected output into reference-run-v1/reference-frame-v1 data.
known_limitations: First-pass configuration may need calibration after output inspection.
If generated output becomes widespread low stratus, keep that evidence separate from the shallow-cumulus baseline.
This case is a humid contrast, not universal low-cloud truth.
notes: CM1 is offline reference-model output; Cloud Lab does not run CM1 in normal app sessions.
No generated CM1 output is committed with this manifest.
Validation status remains planned until real local output is generated, ingested, and manually inspected.
